cam.tip: ✈ Kuguruka kw'ikamera. KURIKIRA (V) — subira kuri seli
dTip.age: Inama: Ubusaza ntibawurwanya. Gabanya mbere yo gupfa.
dTip.eaten: Inama: Kirinda abahigi, koresha Igihe cy'Impuhwe kugira ngo uhungane.
dTip.lysis: Inama: Virusi ni byo bitera icwa. Kirinda byo.
dTip.starve: Inama: Fungura kenshi, komeza hafi y'aho ibiribwa biri, cyangwa hindura umuvuduko.
dTip.temp: Inama: Reba ikoneri ry'ubushyuhe. Hindura urugero rw'ubushyuhe rwawe.
demo.tip: EREKANA · WASD/imbeba kuguruka · 1-6 simbuka itsinda · kanda = ufate
edu.chloro.desc: Kora isukari mu rumuri: urumuri + CO₂ + H₂O → isukari + O₂. Icyatsi kiva muri chlorophyl. Byibasira ibimera byo mu mazi n'ibimera.
edu.chloro.name: Kloroplasite
edu.cilia.desc: Ubuyobera buke bwa seli. Bwakora ibyerekezo by'amazi: kwimuka no kurondera ibiribwa (kuratora bakiteriya n'ibimera byo mu mazi byerekejwe mu kanwa).
edu.cilia.name: Silia
edu.cyto.desc: Ibiri mu nda ya seli: amazi, proteyine, organella. Ibihumbi by'ibikorwa bya kemiyabure bibera hano.
edu.cyto.name: Sitoplasmu
edu.flagella.desc: Imashini yo koga ireshyi. Izenguruka cyangwa ikoroha — seli igera ku biribwa cyangwa ihungana n'ingaruka (chemotaxis).
edu.flagella.name: Umwibo
edu.hoverHint: Korohereza akadomo mu nda ya seli — izina n'akamaro kayo
edu.membrane.desc: Igishisho cyoroheje cya lipide. Kigenzura ibyinjira n'ibisohoka. Seli iyo ari yo iyose ifite igishisho.
edu.membrane.name: Igihisho cya seli
edu.mito.desc: Uruganda r'ingufu rya seli. Kwihutirwa: isukari + O₂ → ATP (ingufu). Rifite DNA ryaryo — ibyasigaye muri bakiteriya ya kera.
edu.mito.name: Mitokondiriya
edu.nucleoid.desc: Umwanya ufite DNA y'uruziga muri prokaryote. Nta gihisho k'ikirenga — DNA iserera mu sitoplasmu ku bwite.
edu.nucleoid.name: Nukleoyidi
edu.nucleus.desc: Bika DNA. Genzura gukura, ugabanywa no korwa proteyine. Bakiteriya ntifite nukleusi y'ukuri — DNA iba mu nukleoyidi.
edu.nucleus.name: Nukleusi
edu.oral.desc: Mu silia — umwobo aho silia ishyira ibyo kurya. Ibiribwa biyinjira mu vakuole yo kugogora bivuye hano.
edu.oral.name: Umwobo w'akanwa
edu.vacuole.desc: Agatebo kafite amazi, ibyabitswe cyangwa enzime zo kugogora. Silia ifite agatebo ko kugogora n'ako ko kuvomu amazi.
edu.vacuole.name: Vakuole
edu.wall.desc: Urukuta rukomeye hanze y'igishisho cya seli (peptidoglikani mu bakiteriya, seluloze mu bimera). Kurinda no kuguma ishusho.
edu.wall.name: Urukuta rwa seli
help.body:
Igenzura: WASD koga. Space = kuruma. LMB = koga ugana aho bishushanye.

Ni nde urya nde:

🌱 Ibyatsi birya urumuri. 🔵 Abarya bito barya ibyatsi. 🟠 Abarya biringaniye bayungurura bakiteriya+ibyatsi. 🟣 Abahigi bakuru barya ibyatsi, bakiteriya n'abarya biringaniye — kandi bashobora kuruma byasa n'binini bike.

Ikamera: F ikamera ku bwite, V subira kuri seli. Uruziga = kwegera.

Igabanywa: Rya, kukura, gabanya. Q = n'intoki.
lb.title: 🏆 Ababanza
mapTip: Ikarita nto: aho uri mu cyuzi. Kanda ikamera igera.
menuSub: Igikoresho cy'ibinyabuzima bito — ubwoko {n} + virusi. Igaragaza icyuzi mu ndunduro.
midEaterTip: Urya uri hagati: ogera ku byatsi cyangwa bakiteriya. Silia yungurura ubwayo.
popTip: Igrafu ry'umubare: ingahe ibinyabuzima mu gihe runaka.
role.consumer1: Abarya bito (bakiteriya). Barya ibyatsi bike. Ibiribwa by'abarya biringaniye n'abakuru.
role.consumer2: Abarya biringaniye (silia). Bayungurura amazi: bakuratora bakiteriya n'ibyatsi. Ntibakwiye guhangana n'ibinini.
role.consumer3: Abahigi bakuru. Barya ibyatsi, bakiteriya n'abarya biringaniye. Bashobora kuruma byasa n'binini bike — biva ku mahirwe. Baramenye kubaho igihe kirekire badafite ibiribwa, ariko inzara ikomeza kwica.
role.macrophage: Abarinzi. Bakubita seli endwari cyangwa ezahuza — ubwiza bwa icyuzi.
role.producer: Ibyatsi. Nta guhiga. Barya urumuri n'amazi — ibimera bito. Baha abandi bose ibiribwa.
roleHint: Inama: ibiribwa biragaragazwa n'uruziga rw'ibara. Umurongo w'impumuro y'ibiribwa uri hejuru iburyo.
tip.ageBar: Imyaka y'ikinyabuzima. Seli zaweze zishira ingufu vuba.
tip.cbFilter: Iyungurura ry'ibinyabuzima. Kanda ugaragaze ubu bwoko gusa mu bikubiyemo.
tip.daysL: Iminsi y'umukino. Guhindura ibiha bitera ubushyuhe.
tip.energyBar: Ingufu z'ikinyabuzima. Zihinda kare zitagize umutekano — urupfu rw'inzara.
tip.fly: Kuguruka ku bwite: F cyangwa WASD / imbeba
tip.fpsL: Amafoto kuri isegonda (FPS). Yerekana imikorere y'umukino.
tip.lightL: Urugere rw'urumuri. Byiza ku ifotosinte y'ibyatsi.
tip.popC: Igrafu ry'umubare. Ryerekana amateka y'ibyavutse n'ibyapfuye.
toast.cyst.enter: Ihumure: urinzwe, umuvuduko 0, ingufu zihinda buhoro
toast.cyst.hunger: Inzara: ari mu ihumure — shakisha ibiribwa uko uko
toast.divfail: Igabanywa: seli ya kabiri ntiyashoboye kwiyuhutsa
toast.eat.noneAuto: Nta biribwa hafi — fungura OTOMATIKE cyangwa yegereza
toast.microOn: 🔬 Mikorosikopo: amazi aracyari, kwegera+imikorere (ntibwo uburyo N)
tut.s1.body: Uri ikinyabuzima gito mu cyuzi. Intego: rya, kukura, gabanya. Kanda Ibikurikira.
tut.s1.title: Murakaza neza
tut.s2.body: WASD kugira ngo ugame. Imbeba yerekana icyerekezo. Sensa, hanyuma kanda Ibikurikira.
tut.s2.title: Kwimuka
tut.s3.body: Ogera kuri seli nto ukanda LYA (E). Ugomba kubona urumuri akanya gato.
tut.s3.title: Kurya
tut.s4.body: Mu gihe ingufu zuzuye, kanda GABANYA (Q). Seli ihinduka nto. Ibyo ni byo bisanzwe.
tut.s4.title: Igabanywa
tut.s5.body: Ikamera: kurikira cyangwa kuguruka ku bwite. Umunsi mwiza mu kwyangiri!
tut.s5.title: Byarangiye
